news.body:
## Monday collides with itself
- Business Foundations runs 12:30 to 19:00 your time from Monday, every day that week.
Both of Monday's items sit inside that. The Kraft Heinz CV form closes at 13:30, an hour into day one, and collecting the passport is a trip across Delhi on a weekday afternoon. - Do the CV this weekend, and find out today whether the visa centre opens on a Saturday.

## The half of x360 that is not yours
- x360 wrote on the 11th: neither your self-assessment nor your feedback providers are in.
The providers are the part that waits on other people, so the 11 December date only holds if the nominations go out before the module week takes your days. - Nominate them this weekend; the self-assessment can follow.
